description: cvrt-lang 0.10.0+: run one importer step or `all` from WPML or Polylang into Lang (POST /migrate/{source}). A DRY RUN unless apply is true: the dry run reports what would be written and writes nothing (works read-only). Apply is refused while the source plugin is active and is rolled back only by a fort backup: run fort_backup_create first. The `urls` step reads a URL list from the server and runs only in WP-CLI (`wp cvrt-lang migrate <source> urls --urls=<file>`), so it is not offered here. resume continues an interrupted apply; batch = rows per chunk (1-2000, server default 500).

resume.description: Continue an interrupted apply from its saved position

source.description: Import source: wpml or polylang (the plugin the site is moving away from)

step.description: Step to run, or all (urls is CLI only)

name: lang_migrate_run
